title: Calendar
summary: A small month grid to pick or show a date, with marks, minimum and maximum, and full keyboard control.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected day, an ISO date such as 2026-09-19.

props.name: month
props.description: An ISO date whose month is shown; defaults to the value or today.

props.name: locale
props.description: Language of month and weekday names; defaults to the page language.

props.name: marks
props.description: ISO dates that get a dot.

props.name: range
props.description: Pick a range of days instead of one: the first click sets the start, the second the end (swapped when earlier), the days between are highlighted and a pending range previews under the pointer or focus. Escape drops a pending start.

props.name: start
props.description: Range mode: the first day of the range, an ISO date such as 2026-09-01.

props.name: end
props.description: Range mode: the last day of the range, an ISO date such as 2026-09-14.

events.name: pk-select
events.description: A day was chosen. Cancel to keep the current value.

events.name: pk-range-change
events.detail: { start: string, end: string, valid: boolean }
events.description: Range mode: the second click set the end and the range is complete. The same detail as pk-date-range-picker; valid is always true here because min and max cannot be picked past.

parts.name: status
parts.description: A visually hidden polite live region for range mode (Range start set to ..., Range: ... to ...).

cssProperties.name: --pk-calendar-cell
cssProperties.description: Day size: the touch target on a phone, 2rem on desktop.

a11y: role=grid with a live month title; one roving focused day; arrows move by a day or a week, Home and End to the month edges, PageUp and PageDown by a month (Shift a year). The selected day has aria-selected, today aria-current=date; out-of-range days are disabled buttons with full-date labels. In range mode the start and end days have aria-selected and their labels add range start, range end or in range; a polite live region announces Range start set to X and Range: X to Y; Enter or Space picks the focused day, arrows move focus and preview a pending range, Escape drops a pending start.

examples.title: Range mode with minimum and maximum, Monday start
examples.html: <pk-calendar range week-start="1" month="2026-09-01" min="2026-09-07" max="2026-09-25" start="2026-09-14" end="2026-09-18"></pk-calendar>
